analysis.scope_and_question: The review examines environmental surface and air contamination of Monkeypox virus (MPXV) in household and healthcare settings, focusing on the central question of whether contaminated surfaces and air contribute to MPXV transmission dynamics beyond direct contact with infected skin lesions or body fluids.
analysis.evidence_base_and_review_method: This systematic review searched for studies reporting environmental surface or air sampling for MPXV in clinical or household settings, extracting data on sampling methods, timing, detection metrics, and viral culture results. Twenty-three studies met inclusion criteria, with molecular and culture-based analyses conducted across 391 surfaces and air samples.
analysis.consensus_and_key_conclusions: Environmental contamination with MPXV DNA is frequently detectable in both household and healthcare settings, with 73.1% of 391 direct patient-contact surfaces PCR-positive and median Ct of 32.2 (range: 16.1–39.0). Porous materials like bedding showed lower median Ct values than non-porous surfaces. Air sampling showed PCR positivity in over half of eligible samples, though viral loads were generally low. Viable virus was recovered in a minority of samples, predominantly from surfaces with lower Ct values.
analysis.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: Detection of MPXV DNA does not consistently correlate with viral viability, and confirmed occupational transmission among healthcare workers remains rare despite documented environmental contamination. The review highlights heterogeneity in sampling methods and the need for standardized approaches to assess the clinical relevance of environmental contamination.
analysis.research_and_practice_implications: Further studies incorporating standardized sampling methods and culture-based viability assessments are needed to define the clinical relevance of environmental MPXV contamination. Enhanced surveillance and infection control measures in high-risk settings may be warranted, particularly where direct contact transmission is less evident.

analysis.summary_en: This systematic review synthesizes evidence on Monkeypox virus (MPXV) environmental contamination in household and healthcare settings. It finds frequent detection of MPXV DNA on surfaces (73.1% PCR-positive) and in air samples (over half PCR-positive), with porous materials showing higher contamination levels. However, viable virus recovery was rare and predominantly linked to lower Ct values, indicating limited correlation between DNA detection and infectivity. Despite environmental contamination, confirmed healthcare worker infections without direct contact were uncommon, suggesting direct contact remains the primary transmission route. Standardized sampling and viability assessments are needed to clarify the role of environmental contamination in transmission dynamics.

elements_zh.scope_and_question: 该综述检查了家庭和医疗机构中猴痘病毒 (MPXV) 的环境表面和空气污染,重点关注受污染的表面和空气是否会影响 MPXV 传播 动态,而不仅仅是直接接触受感染的皮肤损伤或体液。
elements_zh.evidence_base_and_review_method: 本系统综述检索了报告临床或家庭环境中 MPXV 环境表面或空气采样的研究,提取了有关采样方法、时间、检测指标和病毒培养结果的数据。23 项研究符合纳入标准,对 391 个表面和空气样本进行了基于分子和培养的分析。
elements_zh.consensus_and_key_conclusions: MPXV DNA 环境污染在家庭和医疗机构中经常可检测到,391 个患者直接接触表面中有 73.1% 呈 PCR 阳性,Ct 中位数为 32.2(范围:16.1-39.0)。多孔材料(如垫料)的 Ct 值中值低于无孔表面。空气采样显示,超过一半的合格样本呈 PCR 阳性,但病毒载量普遍较低。在少数样品中发现了活病毒,主要来自 Ct 值较低的表面。
elements_zh.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: MPXV DNA 的检测并不总是与病毒活力相关,尽管有环境污染记录,但在医护人员中确认的职业 传播 仍然很少见。该综述强调了采样方法的异质性以及采用标准化方法来评估环境污染的临床相关性的必要性。
elements_zh.research_and_practice_implications: 需要结合标准化采样方法和基于培养的活力评估的进一步研究来确定环境 MPXV 污染的临床相关性。在高风险环境中加强 监测 和感染控制措施可能是必要的,特别是在直接接触 传播 不太明显的情况下。

title_zh: 家庭和医疗机构中 MPXV 的环境表面和空气污染:检测和可行性的系统评价
source_body_en: Mpox virus (MPXV) transmission primarily occurs through direct contact with infected skin lesions or body fluids. However, the 2022 and 2024 global outbreaks renewed concerns regarding the potential contribution of contaminated surfaces and air to transmission dynamics. This systematic review aimed to synthesize current evidence on environmental surface and air contamination of MPXV in household and healthcare settings. A systematic search of the literature was conducted to identify studies reporting environmental surface or air sampling for MPXV in clinical or household settings. Data were extracted on sampling methods, timing, detection metrics, and viral culture results. Surfaces were categorized into functional groups to allow cross-study comparison, and median Ct values were calculated when sample-level data were available. Healthcare worker (HCW) exposure and infection outcomes were also descriptively analysed. Twenty-three studies met the inclusion criteria. Across 391 direct patient-contact surfaces with analysable molecular data, 73.1% were PCR-positive for MPXV DNA. Among samples reporting Ct values, the median Ct was 32.2 (range: 16.1–39.0), while quantitative viral loads ranged from 0.301 to 5.38 log10 copies/cm2. Porous materials, particularly bedding and soft surfaces, demonstrated lower median Ct values compared to non-porous surfaces. Air sampling showed PCR positivity in over half of eligible samples, although viral loads were generally low. Viral culture was performed in a subset of studies, with viable virus recovered in a minority of samples, predominantly from surfaces with lower Ct values. Among 543 exposed healthcare workers, only 4 became infected without direct contact or sharps injury, despite documented environmental contamination in several settings. No additional HCW infections occurred during follow-up in most studies. Environmental contamination with MPXV DNA is frequently detectable in both household and healthcare settings. However, detection of viral DNA does not consistently correlate with viral viability, and confirmed occupational transmission among healthcare workers remains rare. Current evidence supports the predominance of direct contact transmission, while environmental contamination may represent a contextual amplification factor under specific conditions. Further studies incorporating standardized sampling methods and culture-based viability assessments are needed to better define the clinical relevance of environmental MPXV contamination.
abstract_zh: 猴痘病毒 (MPXV) 传播 主要通过直接接触受感染的皮肤损伤或体液发生。然而,2022 年和 2024 年全球 暴发 再次引发了人们对受污染表面和空气对 传播 动态的潜在影响的担忧。本系统综述旨在综合有关家庭和医疗机构中 MPXV 环境表面和空气污染的最新证据。对文献进行了系统检索,以确定报告临床或家庭环境中 MPXV 环境表面或空气采样的研究。提取了有关采样方法、时间、检测指标和病毒培养结果的数据。将表面分类为功能组以进行交叉研究比较,并在样本水平数据可用时计算中位 Ct 值。还对医护人员 (HCW) 的暴露和感染结果进行了描述性分析。二十三项研究符合纳入标准。在具有可分析分子数据的 391 个直接与患者接触的表面中,73.1% 的 MPXV DNA PCR 呈阳性。在报告 Ct 值的样本中,中位 Ct 为 32.2(范围:16.1-39.0),而定量病毒载量范围为 0.301 至 5.38 log10 拷贝/cm2。与无孔表面相比,多孔材料,特别是床上用品和软表面,表现出较低的中位 Ct 值。尽管病毒载量普遍较低,但空气采样显示超过一半的合格样本呈 PCR 阳性。在一部分研究中进行了病毒培养,在少数样品中回收了活病毒,主要来自 Ct 值较低的表面。在 543 名暴露的医护人员中,只有 4 人在没有直接接触或锐器伤害的情况下被感染,尽管有记录显示在一些环境中存在环境污染。大多数研究在随访期间没有发生额外的医护人员感染。在家庭和医疗机构中,经常可以检测到 MPXV DNA 造成的环境污染。然而,病毒 DNA 的检测并不总是与病毒活力相关,并且在医护人员中确认的职业 传播 仍然很少。目前的证据支持直接接触 传播 的主导地位,而环境污染可能代表特定条件下的背景放大因素。需要进一步研究结合标准化采样方法和基于培养的活力评估,以更好地确定环境 MPXV 污染的临床相关性。

analysis_zh.evidence_base_and_review_method: 本系统综述检索了报告临床或家庭环境中 MPXV 环境表面或空气采样的研究,提取了有关采样方法、时间、检测指标和病毒培养结果的数据。23 项研究符合纳入标准,对 391 个表面和空气样本进行了基于分子和培养的分析。
analysis_zh.consensus_and_key_conclusions: MPXV DNA 环境污染在家庭和医疗机构中经常可检测到,391 个患者直接接触表面中有 73.1% 呈 PCR 阳性,Ct 中位数为 32.2(范围:16.1-39.0)。多孔材料(如垫料)的 Ct 值中值低于无孔表面。空气采样显示,超过一半的合格样本呈 PCR 阳性,但病毒载量普遍较低。在少数样品中发现了活病毒,主要来自 Ct 值较低的表面。
analysis_zh.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: MPXV DNA 的检测并不总是与病毒活力相关,尽管有环境污染记录,但在医护人员中确认的职业 传播 仍然很少见。该综述强调了采样方法的异质性以及采用标准化方法来评估环境污染的临床相关性的必要性。
analysis_zh.research_and_practice_implications: 需要结合标准化采样方法和基于培养的活力评估的进一步研究来确定环境 MPXV 污染的临床相关性。在高风险环境中加强 监测 和感染控制措施可能是必要的,特别是在直接接触 传播 不太明显的情况下。

title: A EVOLUÇÃO DOS EVENTOS PANDÊMICOS EM SAÚDE PÚBLICA: DESDE OS PRIMÓRDIOS DA HISTÓRIA ATÉ A ATUALIDADE
abstract: A história da humanidade é marcada por eventos pandêmicos, epidêmicos e surtos que transcendem a crise sanitária, gerando também crises econômicas, políticas e sociais. Tais ocorrências são vistas como grandes desequilíbrios ecológicos, biológicos e sociais, cuja disseminação é potencializada pela mobilidade global de pessoas e bens. O objetivo deste artigo é analisar a progressão desses cenários globais que impactaram a Saúde Pública. A metodologia empregada foi uma revisão bibliográfica de natureza qualitativa, utilizando bases como a Biblioteca Virtual em Saúde e resultando na análise de 62 artigos científicos. Os resultados demonstram a evolução do conhecimento e das estratégias de enfrentamento ao longo do tempo. Na Antiguidade, prevaleciam as explicações religiosas e a queima de corpos, progredindo para a prática de quarentena na Idade Média e, com a ciência moderna, para o isolamento de agentes etiológicos e o uso de proteção individual. O estudo revisita cronologicamente eventos devastadores como a Peste de Atenas, a Peste Negra, Gripe Espanhola, HIV/AIDS, até as mais recentes pandemias de SARS, H1N1, Ebola, Covid-19 e Mpox. A pandemia de Covid-19 destacou a necessidade de se considerar esses eventos como fenômenos complexos, não-lineares e multipolares (clínica, econômica, social e política). Conclui-se que o enfrentamento requer aprendizado contínuo com a história e, no contexto brasileiro, o fortalecimento de um sistema de saúde público como o Sistema Único de Saúde (SUS), valorizando a Atenção Primária em Saúde, o Programa Nacional de Imunização e a integração de ações de vigilância em saúde entre os entes federativos.

analysis.summary_en: This study examines the historical evolution of pandemics and their multifaceted impacts on public health, economics, and society. It highlights the progression of responses from ancient religious explanations to modern strategies involving quarantine, isolation, and individual protection. The research emphasizes the complexity of pandemics, particularly in the context of the COVID-19 pandemic, and underscores the importance of learning from history to strengthen public health systems, such as Brazil's SUS, and improve integrated health surveillance. The study is a qualitative literature review of 62 scientific articles, providing a broad overview of pandemic development without focusing on specific viral characteristics or detailed methodologies. While the findings offer insights into historical patterns and public health strategies, they do not provide target-specific evidence about the Mpox virus, which is a supplementary entity in this context.

title_zh: 公共事件的演变: DESDE OS PRIMÓRDIOS DA HISTÓRIA ATÉ A ATUALIDADE
source_body_en: A história da humanidade é marcada por eventos pandêmicos, epidêmicos e surtos que transcendem a crise sanitária, gerando também crises econômicas, políticas e sociais. Tais ocorrências são vistas como grandes desequilíbrios ecológicos, biológicos e sociais, cuja disseminação é potencializada pela mobilidade global de pessoas e bens. O objetivo deste artigo é analisar a progressão desses cenários globais que impactaram a Saúde Pública. A metodologia empregada foi uma revisão bibliográfica de natureza qualitativa, utilizando bases como a Biblioteca Virtual em Saúde e resultando na análise de 62 artigos científicos. Os resultados demonstram a evolução do conhecimento e das estratégias de enfrentamento ao longo do tempo. Na Antiguidade, prevaleciam as explicações religiosas e a queima de corpos, progredindo para a prática de quarentena na Idade Média e, com a ciência moderna, para o isolamento de agentes etiológicos e o uso de proteção individual. O estudo revisita cronologicamente eventos devastadores como a Peste de Atenas, a Peste Negra, Gripe Espanhola, HIV/AIDS, até as mais recentes pandemias de SARS, H1N1, Ebola, Covid-19 e Mpox. A pandemia de Covid-19 destacou a necessidade de se considerar esses eventos como fenômenos complexos, não-lineares e multipolares (clínica, econômica, social e política). Conclui-se que o enfrentamento requer aprendizado contínuo com a história e, no contexto brasileiro, o fortalecimento de um sistema de saúde público como o Sistema Único de Saúde (SUS), valorizando a Atenção Primária em Saúde, o Programa Nacional de Imunização e a integração de ações de vigilância em saúde entre os entes federativos.
abstract_zh: 一部关于大流行病、流行病和超越卫生危机、经济危机、政治危机和社会危机的人性历史。这是我们在生态、生物和社会方面取得的重大成果,也是全球范围内动员起来的传播和潜力。我们客观地分析了全球影响公共事业的情况的进展。一种修订自然定性文献的方法,利用虚拟图书馆和 62 种科学文献的分析结果。结果显示了连贯性的演变和长期节奏的策略。反宗教、宗教和身体问题的解释,以及媒体和现代科学的实践,以及对个体病因和个人保护的隔离。我们回顾了阿特纳斯瘟疫、黑死病、西班牙瘟疫、艾滋病毒/艾滋病、最近流行的 SARS、H1N1、埃博拉、Covid-19 和 猴痘 等大流行病的事件。Covid-19 的大流行需要考虑复杂的、非线性的和多极化的事件(临床、经济、社会和政治)。结论是,我们需要继续关注历史,在没有巴西背景的情况下,我们要加强萨乌德公共系统 (SUS)、萨乌德初级预防和国家免疫计划的力度联邦间警戒一体化。
